answers.answer: A) Return 207 Multi-Status with per-item results — the 97 successful orders are committed, the 3 failures include specific error codes, and the client can retry or fix just the failures. HTTP 207 Multi-Status (RFC 4918) is specifically designed for partial success in batch operations. It allows the client to see exactly which items succeeded and which failed, with specific error codes for each failure. This is better than B (too strict - atomic rollback frustrates users when 97% succeeded), C (200 is misleading when there are failures), or D (async is overkill and adds latency for a simple batch operation).
